title: Video Games: Pixel Adventures
description: Arcades to blocky worlds—gaming history in five fun facts.

questions.question: What is Mario's brother's name?
questions.explanation: Luigi started in 1983's Mario Bros. as a green copy of Mario, so two friends could play together. His name sounds like "ruiji," Japanese for "similar," a lucky accident!

questions.question: Luigi's brother Mario first appeared in what arcade game?
questions.explanation: Back in 1981 he was called Jumpman, and he was a carpenter, not a plumber! Nintendo later named him after Mario Segale, the landlord of its warehouse in America.

questions.question: Donkey Kong was made by which Japanese company?
questions.explanation: Nintendo started way back in 1889 in Kyoto, Japan, making playing cards called hanafuda. That's before airplanes were even invented!

questions.question: Nintendo's handheld with two screens had what two-letter name?
questions.explanation: Nintendo sold about 154 million DS systems! It was Nintendo's best-selling console ever, until its newer system, the Switch, finally passed it in 2025.

questions.question: The Switch beat the DS, but the best-selling video game of all time isn't made by Nintendo at all! What blocky building game is it?
questions.hint: You mine blocks and craft tools
questions.explanation: Minecraft has sold more than 350 million copies, more than any other video game ever. It started out in 2009, made by a small studio in Sweden called Mojang.
